review_evidence: The 135-file unit consists entirely of formal Lean sources under Mathlib/Lean, Mathlib/RepresentationTheory, and Mathlib/SetTheory.

Mathlib/Lean modules such as ContextInfo.lean, Elab/InfoTree.lean, and Expr/Basic.lean expose reusable checked metaprogramming/elaboration interfaces, while RepresentationTheory and SetTheory are substantive mathematical libraries.
FILTER-001 treats useful formal interfaces as prior art; no exact subset was proved losslessly irrelevant, so no hard exclusion is introduced.
summary: Retain the Mathlib Lean, RepresentationTheory, and SetTheory bucket as reusable formal interfaces and mathematics.
